english.note: Use this when someone is frantic because they are flustered and struggling to manage their actions.
Use this when people are carrying something out chaotically because they are flustered or under pressure.

examples.english: I frantically fumbled around looking for tools when I made a cake for the first time.
examples.traditional: 我第一次整蛋糕，手忙腳亂咁周圍搵工具。

examples.english: With the assignment due soon, everyone chaotically rushed to finish it.
examples.traditional: 限時交功課，大家手忙腳亂咁趕工。
